verdict.rationale: Buzz shows multiple event-driven automation primitives — the ACP harness listens for @mentions and triggers agent replies (buzz-docs-10, buzz-supp-acp-harness), workflow CLI commands (`buzz workflows trigger/approve`) tie CI events to actions (buzz-docs-8), and a dedicated 'MCP-driven hooks' doc is referenced (buzz-probe-3), plus 'YAML-as-code automation' is listed as a vision feature (buzz-docs-13). These support event-triggered automation but the evidence pack never shows the actual content/flexibility of the hooks/rules DSL, nor independent confirmation it works as a general-purpose rule engine beyond mention-triggering and workflow approval. Missing for 10: full content of MCP_DRIVEN_HOOKS.md showing a general rule-condition-action system, examples of custom event-rule definitions beyond mentions/CI, and independent/hands-on corroboration that automation rules fire reliably.
